meta.description: RSG Gmail Automations — 4 n8n workflows covering COI routing, cancellation alerts, payment issue escalation, and newsletter cleanup

workflows.name: RSG — COI Request Router
workflows.description: Detects incoming COI / Certificate of Insurance requests, labels them RSG-Task, and auto-forwards to the service team

filters.q: (subject:COI OR subject:"certificate of insurance" OR subject:"Missing Certificate") in:inbox

parameters.subject: =FWD [COI REQUEST]: {{ $json.subject }}

workflows.name: RSG — Policy Cancellation Alert
workflows.description: Monitors for cancellation / non-payment notices from carriers and SolePro. Labels them, stars them, and sends a Slack/SMS alert.

filters.q: (subject:"Cancellation Notice" OR subject:"Policy Cancellation" OR subject:"Pending Cancellation" OR subject:"Cancellation for Non-Payment") in:inbox newer_than:1d

string.name: alertMessage

workflows.name: RSG — Payment Issues Escalator
workflows.description: Catches SaaS/vendor payment failures and billing reminders. Labels them Payment Issues, stars them, and sends a daily digest summary.

filters.q: (subject:"Payment Failed" OR subject:"payment was declined" OR subject:"past due" OR subject:"Payment Reminder" OR subject:"subscription renewal failed" OR subject:"Unable to charge" OR subject:"Auto Recharge Payment Failed" OR subject:"Service Suspension") in:inbox newer_than:1d

nodes.name: Add Payment Issues Label
nodes.notes: Replace Label_PAYMENT_ISSUES_ID with the actual label ID after creating the 'Payment Issues' label in Gmail

parameters.subject: =⚠️ Payment Issues Digest — {{ $now.format('MMM D, YYYY') }}
parameters.message:
=The following payment issues were detected today and need your attention:

{{ $json.paymentIssues.map(p => `• ${p.subject}\n  From: ${p.from}\n  Date: ${p.date}`).join('\n\n') }}

---
All items have been labeled 'Payment Issues' in Gmail.
Note: Most failures appear related to Mastercard •••• 2043 — consider updating your default payment method.

workflows.name: RSG — Newsletter & Noise Cleaner
workflows.description: Runs every 6 hours. Finds newsletter/social/marketing emails in inbox and moves them to the Newsletters label, skipping the inbox.

filters.q: (from:substack.com OR from:linkedin.com OR from:facebookmail.com OR from:quora.com OR from:reddit-events@reddit.com OR from:no-reply@spotify.com OR from:chrono24@comms.chrono24.com OR from:hi@mail.theresanaiforthat.com OR from:info@youreverydayai.com OR from:larry.johnson@cobbcountycourier.com OR from:scott@send.referralsdoneright.org OR from:noreply@riskeducation.org OR from:mitsloan@getsmarter.com OR from:marketing@github.com OR from:marketing@optimyl.com OR from:learning@usassure.com) in:inbox

workflows.name: RSG — Tech Alerts Archiver
workflows.description: Runs every 2 hours. Archives GitHub CI failures, codespace warnings, Railway crashes, Cloudflare, n8n, and Supabase system emails into Tech Alerts label.

filters.q: (from:notifications@github.com OR from:noreply@github.com OR from:support@github.com OR from:hello@notify.railway.app OR from:noreply@notify.cloudflare.com OR from:security@info.n8n.io OR from:noreply@supabase.com OR from:no-reply@asana.com OR from:calendar-notification@google.com) in:inbox

nodes.name: Apply Tech Alerts Label
nodes.notes: Replace Label_TECH_ALERTS_ID with the actual label ID after creating the 'Tech Alerts' label in Gmail

step_1_labels.description: Create these two labels in Gmail first (Settings → Labels → Create new label)

step_2_gmail_filters.description: Import the Gmail filter file to handle all future incoming emails automatically
instructions: 1. Go to Gmail Settings → Filters and Blocked Addresses
4. Check 'Apply to matching conversations' to also process existing emails

step_3_n8n_workflows.description: Import workflows into your n8n Cloud instance
instructions: 2. Create New Workflow → Import from JSON for each workflow object in the 'workflows' array
3. Connect your Gmail credential to each Gmail node
4. Connect your Slack credential to the Cancellation Alert workflow
5. Update Label_PAYMENT_ISSUES_ID and Label_TECH_ALERTS_ID with actual IDs from Gmail API

step_4_update_label_ids.description: After creating the Payment Issues and Tech Alerts labels, get their IDs and update the n8n workflows
step_4_update_label_ids.how_to_get_label_ids: Run: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <gmail_token>' 'https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/labels' | jq '.labels[] | select(.name=="Payment Issues") | .id'
